title: Design System: Al Maryah Island · AI Lifestyle Library

display.purpose: Chapter statements (size l); xl, m and s steps exist for threshold/close, sub-sections and small statements.

display-xl.purpose: Threshold statement and closing statement only.

numeral.purpose: Hours, tallies, counts and stats; the day is told in light condensed numerals.

headline.purpose: Idea-chain values, anatomy layer value, record title.

title.purpose: Step, case, gate and ownership names.

lead.purpose: Italic serif line under every chapter head; max 38ch.

prompt.purpose: Generation prompts, the one large serif setting.

label.purpose: Definition terms, table heads, legends, credits, captions heads.

shadows.name: photo-halo-wordmark
shadows.purpose: Legibility of the wordmark over photographs. Not elevation.

shadows.name: photo-halo-hour
shadows.purpose: Legibility of the caption hour over photographs.

shadows.name: photo-halo-stroke
shadows.purpose: Legibility of arrow chevrons over photographs.

shadows.name: highlight-pad
shadows.purpose: Extends a highlighted prompt span's tint; a fill, not a shadow.

overlays.name: scrim-bottom
overlays.purpose: Bottom 34% of the exhibit so the caption bar reads on bright frames; fades out in record state.

overlays.name: scrim-top
overlays.purpose: Top 22% of the exhibit behind wordmark and toggle.

overlays.name: echo-wash
overlays.purpose: Whole-exhibit tint while a specimen record is open (7% on the phone bottom sheet).

overlays.name: dim-leaving
overlays.purpose: The outgoing plate recedes instead of the incoming one lifting.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default slow exponential ease-out for every transition and wipe.

motion.name: ease-io
motion.purpose: Symmetric ease for the looping image drift only.

motion.name: t-slow
motion.purpose: Scene changes: plate moves, echo wash, scrims.

motion.name: record-wipe
motion.value: clip-path inset 1000ms ease, 120ms delay; rows cascade 260ms + i x 34ms
motion.purpose: Specimen record wipe and row stagger.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveal; content is visible without JS.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all durations .01ms, reveals disabled, scroll story unpinned

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: exhibit bar to two rows, record to bottom sheet, worlds stack.

breakpoints.name: split
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: two-up splits and split chapter heads.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: anatomy, stakes and wardrobe multi-column.

breakpoints.name: pipeline
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: pipeline stops scrolling and fits the container.

narrative.overview:
The library is hung as an exhibition after dark. A near-black, Oxford-tinted ground (night ink) holds photographs edge to edge, and the site is navigated as a single day on the island, 07:00 to 22:00. Every frame is both a picture on a wall and a specimen with a catalogue entry: hover or tap and the image steps back while its record wipes in from the edge, tinted by that frame's own colour echo.

The interface is made of type and hairlines, nothing else. Condensed Archivo capitals carry everything that is data (hours, labels, counts, parameter names, chapter statements); Source Serif 4 carries everything that is said (leads, prompts, reading copy), most often in italic. Structure comes from 1px rules at low opacity, never from cards, panels or fills. Density is gallery-sparse in the exhibit and catalogue-dense in the records and process chapters, where definition lists, numbered steps and tables sit on ruled rows.

Colour is mostly withheld. The ground is night ink, text is warm bone, and a single accent at a time comes from the photograph on show: the active frame (or the active chapter) sets `--echo`, and only that echo colours the current tick, the record's edge, the world line and the focus ring. One chapter (Prompt Architecture) flips to a neutral light document grey with ink text, following the source deck's own alternation of dark and light layouts.
keyCharacteristics: Night-ink ground (#070b10), photographs full-bleed or at full column width, square-cornered.
Two-family type system: condensed Archivo caps for data, Source Serif 4 (often italic) for voice.
Hairline rules (1px, 14% bone) as the only structural device; no cards, no panels.
One live accent at a time, the frame's colour echo, set per frame or per chapter.
Slow exponential easing and clip-path wipes; content arrives, it never bounces.

rules.name: The One Echo Rule
rules.body: Only one accent is live on a screen, and it comes from the photograph: the frame's echo in the exhibit, gold in System and Scale, Oxford on the document chapter. Sky Echo is the default, not a second accent.

rules.name: The Rebind Rule
rules.body: A chapter changes world by re-binding tokens (`--line`, `--text-2`, `--text-3`, `--echo`) on its container, never by writing new component colours. The paper chapter is the reference.

rules.name: The Data Wears Caps Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a value, a time, a count or a field name is set in condensed Archivo with tabular figures; anything that is a sentence is set in Source Serif 4. A field name never appears in serif and a statement never in labels.

rules.name: The Narrow Not Heavy Rule
rules.body: Emphasis in Archivo comes from width (62% to 80%) and size; weight stays between 300 and 600.

rules.name: The Lights Down Rule
rules.body: To bring one thing forward, dim everything else; never lift the thing with a shadow. The record wipes in while the frame darkens behind it.

dos: **Do** set every surface on night ink (#070b10) and let photographs run edge to edge or full column width with square corners.
**Do** take the accent from the frame on show by setting `--echo` on the container; use gold for System and Scale and Oxford on the document chapter.
**Do** set times, counts, field names and labels in condensed Archivo caps with tabular figures, and sentences in Source Serif 4.
**Do** group content with 1px hairline top rules and generous vertical rhythm instead of containers.
**Do** show missing data as "Not yet recorded" in slate label type; never omit the field.
**Do** move with the exponential ease (`cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)`) at slow durations (about 1100ms for scene changes) and reveal with clip-path wipes; honour reduced motion by cutting all of it.
donts: **Don't** use cards, panels or filled containers to group content; the ruled row is the container.
**Don't** use box-shadow for elevation or frosted-glass panels; dim the surroundings instead.
**Don't** run two accents at once or introduce a colour that is not a frame echo or a defined signal.
**Don't** round photographs or figures; radius belongs only to pills, dots and 2px tags.
**Don't** set Archivo bold and wide for emphasis; narrow it and scale it.
